question: Which scheme has been launched by the Chief Minister of Kerala in May 2025 to educate migrant children?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyothi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyothi** is the name of the scheme launched by the **Chief Minister of Kerala** in **May 2025**.
 
• The scheme aims to provide education to **migrant children**, ensuring their integration into mainstream education systems.
 
• This initiative seeks to address the challenges faced by migrant children due to language barriers, cultural differences, and the lack of access to quality education. *Hence, statement is correct.*
 
• **Jyothi** involves setting up specialized learning centers and appointing trained educators who understand the unique needs of migrant children.
 
• It also includes providing basic facilities like books, uniforms, and digital tools to ensure a conducive learning environment. *Hence, the correct answer is Jyothi.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Challenges faced by migrant children:**

 
 
• Migrant children often face issues like **language barriers, lack of access to schools, and discrimination**, which hinder their educational progress.
 
• Due to frequent relocations, these children struggle to adapt to new academic and social environments, resulting in high dropout rates.
 
 
 
• **Government initiatives for education:**
 
 
• India has various schemes like **Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan**, aimed at universalizing elementary education.
 
• Specific programs like **Mid-Day Meal Scheme** and **Right to Education Act** focus on retaining students in schools and improving their learning outcomes.
 
 
 
• **Jyothi Scheme – Features and Impact:**
 
 
• The scheme emphasizes **inclusive education** by addressing the unique needs of migrant children.
 
• It includes the creation of **multilingual teaching aids** and appointment of educators proficient in regional languages.
 
• Through specialized centers, Jyothi aims to reduce dropout rates and foster academic growth among migrant children.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key objectives of Jyothi Scheme:**

 
 
• To provide **quality education** to migrant children and integrate them into the mainstream education system.
 
• To create a **supportive learning environment** by addressing language and cultural barriers.
 
 
 
• **Additional efforts in Kerala:**
 
 
• **Kerala** has been proactive in implementing educational reforms, achieving the **highest literacy rate** in India.
 
• The state promotes **inclusive policies**, focusing on marginalized groups and ensuring access to quality education for all.
